We do not propose a new algorithm. Instead, we provide a systematic, controlled investigation answering: *Why does temporal abstraction fail in world-model RL?*\\n\\nThe contribution is a **strongly supported causal chain** from mechanism to failure mode, backed by a factorial experiment design that isolates each factor, plus a **practical mitigation guideline** (restrict imagination to dt=1 during multi-dt training → 95% baseline recovery). Diagnostic papers are valued when they (a) address a widely-attempted but poorly-understood failure, (b) provide actionable insight for future method design, and (c) are methodologically rigorous.\\n\\nWe scope all claims to **DreamerV3 and its RSSM world model**. Generalizability to other latent-dynamics architectures is discussed but not claimed.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Core Claims\\n\\n### C1: Variable-rate imagination in DreamerV3 consistently degrades performance\\n\\nTemporal abstraction via variable dt—whether learned or fixed—degrades asymptotic performance relative to the dt=1 baseline across all tested configurations.\\n\\n| Evidence | Experiment | Key Metric |\\n|----------|-----------|------------|\\n| Baseline stability | exp_001_baseline (dt=1) | Stable convergence ~950 eval return |\\n| Fixed dt=2 collapse | exp_006_fixed_dt2 (dt=2, subsample ON, H=15) | Peak 485@35K → collapse to ~135@65K |\\n| Fixed dt=4 severe degradation | exp_007_fixed_dt4 (dt=4) | Peak 176.9@25K, 144.4@45K (33% of baseline@45K=443) |\\n| Learned gate collapse | exp_005 (learned gate) | Peak 541@55K → 99@145K |\\n\\n**Strength**: Strong. Three independent dt>1 configurations all show degradation. No positive result exists for variable-rate imagination in our setup.\\n\\n### C2: Trained dt_embedding creates susceptibility to CIVO with stochastic onset; necessity confirmed by ablation\\n\\n**D032/D156 update: CIVO onset is stochastic (Walker 3/3, Cheetah 3/4); necessity confirmed (frozen 0/10 across 2 envs × multiple seeds, removed 0/3+). Cross-env frozen verification 4/4 closed (exp_084-087, all NVE < 0.53×). Fisher exact test (6/7 onset vs 0/19 controls): p < 0.0001.**\\n\\nThe trained dt_embedding creates susceptibility to pathological value overestimation (normalized v/e >1.5x baseline) with stochastic onset. Both onset and collapse are stochastic:\\n\\n- **Walker WITH trained dt_emb**: 3/3 seeds onset NVE>1.5× (exp_008d s0: sustained 1.71x@35K→2.09x@45K→4.12x@55K → collapse; exp_009e s1: onset >1.5×; exp_009b s2: 1.62x@45K → self-correction to 0.38x@105K). 2/3 sustained collapse, 1/3 self-corrected\\n- **Cheetah WITH trained dt_emb**: 3/4 seeds onset (exp_078 s0 NVE=4.1×; exp_091 s2 NVE=138.7×, onset_collapse; exp_097 s3 onset@45K NVE=2.3×, onset_transient_then_degraded, eval_final=61.7 (14% baseline); exp_088 s1 NVE≈1.0 no onset). **All onset seeds eval_final < 15% baseline; no-onset s1 = 69% baseline — CIVO onset causes irrecoverable performance damage even when ve_ratio self-corrects**\\n- **WITHOUT dt_emb (frozen/removed)**: 0/10 frozen (exp_042, exp_067, 015b, 047, 057, 084, 085 Walker; 046, 058, 086, 087 Cheetah; note: 047/057 had transient spikes 1.71-1.88× but self-corrected) + 0/3 removed (008f s1, 009c s2, exp_069 s1) exceed sustained nve>1.5×. Cross-env frozen verification (exp_084-087, 2 envs × 2 seeds): all NVE<0.53×\\n- **1.5x threshold (Walker, 35K+)**: 4/4 perfect classification within Walker. Cross-environment onset rate ~86% (6/7 completed seeds) — not deterministic\\n\\n**⚠️ 时间限定**: nve>1.5x 诊断适用于 **35K+ steps**（此时 baseline v/e 已充分收敛至 >0.24，比率稳定可靠）。25K 处 baseline v/e 仅 0.087，微小绝对差异可被放大为大比率（如 009b@25K nve=2.05x 和 008e_v3@25K nve=1.93x 均为 false positive）。论文中报告 threshold 时必须标注此限定。\\n\\n**Sustained vs transient overestimation**: The key difference between collapse (008d seed 1) and self-correction (009b seed 2) is the **temporal persistence** of nve>1.5x. Seed 1 maintained nve>1.5x across 3 consecutive checkpoints at 35K+ (1.71x@35K→2.09x@45K→4.12x@55K, accelerating), locking the positive feedback loop; seed 2 exceeded 1.5x at 45K (1.62x) but dropped to 1.41x@55K and continued declining, allowing self-correction. This suggests a \\\"point of no return\\\" where sustained overestimation becomes irreversible, with early training stochasticity (initialization, data sampling order) determining which path is taken (cf. Henderson et al. 2018, Bjorck et al. 2022, Qiao et al. 2023).\\n\\nThe trained dt_embedding enables precise dt prediction in imagination, but RSSM state prediction quality at dt>1 is insufficient to support this precision. The result is conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO) that drives actor learning toward incorrect policies. Without dt_embedding conditioning, the overestimation feedback loop is blocked entirely (nve never exceeds 1.5x).\\n\\n| Evidence | Experiment | Key Metric |\\n|----------|-----------|------------|\\n| Untrained dt_emb, no collapse | exp_008c (dt=2, subsample OFF, untrained dt_emb, H=8) | eval plateau ~242@55K; v/e: @35K=21.8% (0.90x) → @55K=29.1% (0.72x) → @65K=32.8% (0.58x) (declining normalized v/e, ~7x slower than trained) |\\n| Trained dt_emb, collapse | exp_008d (dt=2, subsample ON, trained dt_emb, H=8) | eval declining 167→146→141 @25K→35K→45K; v/e: @25K=15.5% (1.78x) → @35K=41.2% (1.71x) → @45K=69.3% (2.09x) (accelerating overestimation) |\\n| Both trained dt_emb → accelerating v/e | exp_006 (H=15) vs exp_008d (H=8) | 006: v/e @35K=31.1% (1.29x)→@45K=53.3% (1.61x)→@55K=93.3% (2.31x); 008d: v/e @35K=41.2% (1.71x)→@45K=69.3% (2.09x) — both show accelerating normalized v/e leading to collapse |\\n| Baseline v/e calibration (overshoot reference) | exp_001_baseline | v/e@35K=24.1%, @45K=33.1%, @55K=40.4%. Overshoot ratio: 008d@35K=1.7x, @45K=2.1x; 006@45K=1.6x, @55K=2.3x (all >1.5x = pathological) |\\n| **D032: Trained dt_emb seed 2 — pathological but self-correcting** | exp_009b (008d config, seed 2) | eval 39→141→164→141→172→209→197→236→279→268@105K (**no collapse**, rising). nve: **2.05x@25K**→1.24x→**1.62x@45K**→1.41x→0.94x→0.66x→0.51x→0.43x→**0.38x@105K**. Transient nve>1.5x with self-correction. Value peaked 110.9@65K → self-corrected to 67.3@105K while eval improved. |\\n| **1.5x threshold separating power** | 008d+009b vs 008f+009c | WITH trained dt_emb: 2/2 seeds exceed nve>1.5x (008d peak 2.09x sustained, 009b peak 2.05x transient). WITHOUT dt_emb: 0/2 seeds exceed nve>1.5x (008f peak 1.02x, 009c peak 1.26x). **4/4 perfect classification.** |\\n| **Causal control: dt_embed_dim=0 (direction confirmed, seed-dependent)** | exp_008f seed 1 + exp_009c seed 2 | **Seed 1**: eval 197→207→194→173→503@105K (zigzag recovery); nve 1.02x→0.73x→0.83x→0.97x→0.30x. **Seed 2**: eval 169→211→239→359→227→191→148@105K (decline after 75K); nve 1.26x→0.79x→0.72x→0.33x→0.60x→0.90x→1.14x. architecture)** | exp_016e (reward_dt_emb_detach=True, subsample ON, H=8, seed 1) | Peak eval 326.7@75K → collapse 31.7@95K, NVE=10.42x. 梯度验证揭示 reward loss 对 dt_emb.weight 贡献为 0——reward_dt_emb_detach 是 no-op。016e 与 008d 的差异（onset timing, peak height）归因于随机变异。**⚠️ 修正：reward head 贡献最大梯度（49%@55K），obs decoder 仅 16.3%。但 reward-only SGS 仍失败——梯度大小与因果重要性解耦。** |\\n| **Cheetah 008d seed 3 — onset then Introduction\\n- Temporal abstraction is a long-sought goal in RL (options, macro-actions, skip connections)\\n- World-model RL (DreamerV3) offers a natural testbed: modify imagination dt without changing environment interaction\\n- Puzzle: all our attempts at variable-rate imagination degrade performance. Why?\\n- Contribution: systematic factorial diagnosis identifying trained dt_embedding as creating susceptibility to conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO, nve>1.5x) with stochastic onset (Walker 3/3, Cheetah 3/4); removal/freezing consistently blocks it (0/7+). The vulnerability is deeper than imagination quality — even dt=1 imagination collapses at the same rate when dt_embedding is trained, revealing that training data dt>1 transitions alone drive the critic exploitation feedback loop\\n\\n### 2. Background & Related Work\\n- Temporal abstraction in model-free RL (options framework, FiGAR, action repeat)\\n- World-model RL (Dreamer family, IRIS, TWM)\\n- Variable-rate planning in world models (few prior works, mostly positive framing)\\n- Value overestimation in model-based RL (delusional bias per Lu et al. 2018 — differentiate from our CIVO)\\n\\n### 3. Methodology\\n- DreamerV3 as base architecture\\n- Variable-rate imagination: dt_embedding, temporal subsampling, learned gating\\n- **Factorial experiment design**: 2×2×2 grid (dt_embedding trained/untrained × subsample ON/OFF × H=8/15) + baselines\\n- Diagnostic metrics: eval return, value/eval ratio as overestimation proxy, learning curves\\n\\n### 4. Results\\n- **Finding 1**: All dt>1 configurations degrade (C1)\\n- **Finding 2**: Controlled ablation isolates trained dt_embedding (C2) — the \\\"smoking gun\\\" comparison (008c vs 008d)\\n- **Finding 3**: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, sustaining near-baseline performance (C3)\\n- **Finding 4**: Longer dt amplifies (C4)\\n- **Finding 5**: Horizon/subsample effects are secondary (C5)\\n- **Finding 6 (D153 confirmed)**: dt=1 imagination deterministically prevents CIVO (4/4 seeds, current code after gate_max_dt bug fix). Discussion\\n- Mechanism: why trained dt_embedding causes CIVO (RSSM fidelity gap at dt>1)\\n- RSSM fidelity analysis: Walker 008d reward gap (1.63x, v3 standardized) vs 008f reward gap (1.01x); Cheetah trained_dt_emb reward gap (1.00x) — environment-dependent transmission pathway (D158)\\n- **D153: dt=1 imagination confirmed as deterministic mitigation** (4/4 seeds, gate_max_dt bug fixed). Implications for Future Work\\n- **D113: Intervention Hierarchy — all three levels fail or partially fail**: Gradient (SGS 1/17), Output (RAVE 0/2), Representation (TCN 2/8 with high variance). dt_embedding removal 5/5 but removes the feature entirely.\\n- TCN existence proof (Walker σ=0.2) shows mitigation is *possible in principle* but fragile — narrow dose window, environment-dependent, high seed variance in eval retention\\n- **Dose-environment dependency**: No universal σ exists; Walker-effective dose (σ=0.2) underdoses Cheetah/PickCube, Walker-overdose (σ=0.5) still underdoses Cheetah\\n- RSSM prediction quality must improve before variable-rate imagination is viable\\n- Hierarchical temporal abstraction (THICK, Hieros) may avoid flat-conditioning failure by maintaining separate dynamics per temporal scale\\n- Need for diagnostic methodology in temporal abstraction research\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns\\n\\n### R1: \\\"Limited to one environment / one base algorithm\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: Our claims are mechanistic (trained dt_embedding → value overestimation → collapse). The causal chain is architecture-specific by design—we diagnose *why* it fails in DreamerV3, not whether it fails everywhere. The trained dt_embedding mechanism may have analogues in other latent-dynamics models, though the specific transmission pathway (RSSM fidelity gap vs value extrapolation) appears environment-dependent.\\n**Mitigation**: Cheetah Run is a planned experiment in our experiment schedule, not a stretch goal. We will include at least one additional DMC environment (Cheetah Run) to demonstrate generality of the mechanism.\\n\\n### R2: \\\"No proposed solution — what's the actionable takeaway?\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: Our primary contribution is diagnostic, not prescriptive. Beyond diagnosis, we provide a **systematic Intervention Hierarchy** evaluating 7+ methods across 3 levels (gradient/output/representation) and 3 environments. This is the most comprehensive evaluation of CIVO interventions to date. The key finding: even the most promising intervention (TCN, representation-level) succeeds only under narrow conditions (Walker σ=0.2, 2/8 configs, 45-91% eval retention). The actionable takeaway is that CIVO requires fundamental architectural solutions (hierarchical temporal abstraction per THICK/Hieros), not post-hoc interventions.\\n**Mitigation**: The Intervention Hierarchy table (7 methods × 3 levels) is a standalone contribution — it saves future researchers from re-exploring these dead ends and provides a systematic framework for evaluating future interventions.\\n\\n### R3: \\\"Value/eval ratio is a crude proxy for overestimation\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: We acknowledge this is a proxy, not a formal divergence measure. Introduction\\n- Temporal abstraction is a long-sought goal in RL (options, macro-actions, skip connections)\\n- World-model RL (DreamerV3) offers a natural testbed: modify imagination dt without changing environment interaction\\n- Puzzle: all our attempts at variable-rate imagination degrade performance. Why?\\n- Contribution: systematic factorial diagnosis identifying trained dt_embedding as creating susceptibility to conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO, nve>1.5x) with stochastic onset (Walker 3/3, Cheetah 3/4); removal/freezing consistently blocks it (0/7+). The vulnerability is deeper than imagination quality — even dt=1 imagination collapses at the same rate when dt_embedding is trained, revealing that training data dt>1 transitions alone drive the critic exploitation feedback loop\\n\\n### 2. Background & Related Work\\n- Temporal abstraction in model-free RL (options framework, FiGAR, action repeat)\\n- World-model RL (Dreamer family, IRIS, TWM)\\n- Variable-rate planning in world models (few prior works, mostly positive framing)\\n- Value overestimation in model-based RL (delusional bias per Lu et al. 2018 — differentiate from our CIVO)\\n\\n### 3. Methodology\\n- DreamerV3 as base architecture\\n- Variable-rate imagination: dt_embedding, temporal subsampling, learned gating\\n- **Factorial experiment design**: 2×2×2 grid (dt_embedding trained/untrained × subsample ON/OFF × H=8/15) + baselines\\n- Diagnostic metrics: eval return, value/eval ratio as overestimation proxy, learning curves\\n\\n### 4. Results\\n- **Finding 1**: All dt>1 configurations degrade (C1)\\n- **Finding 2**: Controlled ablation isolates trained dt_embedding (C2) — the \\\"smoking gun\\\" comparison (008c vs 008d)\\n- **Finding 3**: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, sustaining near-baseline performance (C3)\\n- **Finding 4**: Longer dt amplifies (C4)\\n- **Finding 5**: Horizon/subsample effects are secondary (C5)\\n- **Finding 6 (D153 confirmed)**: dt=1 imagination deterministically prevents CIVO (4/4 seeds, current code after gate_max_dt bug fix). Practical mitigation: retain trained dt_embedding benefits while eliminating CIVO trigger pathway (C6)\\n\\n### 5. Discussion\\n- Mechanism: why trained dt_embedding causes CIVO (RSSM fidelity gap at dt>1)\\n- RSSM fidelity analysis: Walker 008d reward gap (1.63x, v3 standardized) vs 008f reward gap (1.01x); Cheetah trained_dt_emb reward gap (1.00x) — environment-dependent transmission pathway (D158)\\n- **D153: dt=1 imagination confirmed as deterministic mitigation** (4/4 seeds, gate_max_dt bug fixed). Old \\\"Pathway B\\\" was bug artifact\\n- **D107: Gradient-level interventions fail entirely**: SGS 0/3 (full) + 1/6 (obs-decoder) + 0/2 (reward-only) = backward-pass is categorically insufficient. Gradient magnitude ≠ causal importance (reward 38-49% but reward-only SGS fails worst; obs-decoder 16-22% but targeted SGS also fails). Forward-pass representational damage is the irreducible floor.\\n- **Compensatory amplification**: Blocking obs-decoder on Cheetah → 2.6-3.6× NVE amplification vs untreated. Blocking reward → obs-decoder reliance increases → spatial bias reinforced.\\n- **Universal value collapse**: Obs-decoder SGS degrades all seeds' critic calibration (ve_ratio 0.056-0.14 @215K), including CIVO-free seeds. \\\"Protection\\\" = trading overestimation for underestimation.\\n- **Fourth CIVO trajectory (s3)**: Latent onset → delayed collapse → policy recovery → persistent value collapse. CIVO-induced critic damage may be irreversible.\\n- MPC vs imagination: TAWM succeeds because MPC re-plans from real states; imagination-based critic bootstrapping creates the positive feedback loop\\n- **D032: Value self-correction mechanism (009b)**: Transient vs sustained nve>1.5x determines outcome. Early stochasticity (initialization, data sampling) is the gate.\\n\\n### 6. Implications for Future Work\\n- **D113: Intervention Hierarchy — all three levels fail or partially fail**: Gradient (SGS 1/17), Output (RAVE 0/2), Representation (TCN 2/8 with high variance). dt_embedding removal 5/5 but removes the feature entirely.\\n- TCN existence proof (Walker σ=0.2) shows mitigation is *possible in principle* but fragile — narrow dose window, environment-dependent, high seed variance in eval retention\\n- **Dose-environment dependency**: No universal σ exists; Walker-effective dose (σ=0.2) underdoses Cheetah/PickCube, Walker-overdose (σ=0.5) still underdoses Cheetah\\n- RSSM prediction quality must improve before variable-rate imagination is viable\\n- Hierarchical temporal abstraction (THICK, Hieros) may avoid flat-conditioning failure by maintaining separate dynamics per temporal scale\\n- Need for diagnostic methodology in temporal abstraction research\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns\\n\\n### R1: \\\"Limited to one environment / one base algorithm\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: Our claims are mechanistic (trained dt_embedding → value overestimation → collapse). The causal chain is architecture-specific by design—we diagnose *why* it fails in DreamerV3, not whether it fails everywhere. The trained dt_embedding mechanism may have analogues in other latent-dynamics models, though the specific transmission pathway (RSSM fidelity gap vs value extrapolation) appears environment-dependent.\\n**Mitigation**: Cheetah Run is a planned experiment in our experiment schedule, not a stretch goal. We will include at least one additional DMC environment (Cheetah Run) to demonstrate generality of the mechanism.\\n\\n### R2: \\\"No proposed solution — what's the actionable takeaway?\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: Our primary contribution is diagnostic, not prescriptive. Beyond diagnosis, we provide a **systematic Intervention Hierarchy** evaluating 7+ methods across 3 levels (gradient/output/representation) and 3 environments. This is the most comprehensive evaluation of CIVO interventions to date. The key finding: even the most promising intervention (TCN, representation-level) succeeds only under narrow conditions (Walker σ=0.2, 2/8 configs, 45-91% eval retention). The actionable takeaway is that CIVO requires fundamental architectural solutions (hierarchical temporal abstraction per THICK/Hieros), not post-hoc interventions.\\n**Mitigation**: The Intervention Hierarchy table (7 methods × 3 levels) is a standalone contribution — it saves future researchers from re-exploring these dead ends and provides a systematic framework for evaluating future interventions.\\n\\n### R3: \\\"Value/eval ratio is a crude proxy for overestimation\\\"\\n**Pre-emption**: We acknowledge this is a proxy, not a formal divergence measure. ## Title Candidates

1. **"Why Temporal Abstraction Fails in DreamerV3: A Diagnostic Analysis of Variable-Rate Imagination"**
2. ~~**"The Delusional Critic Problem in DreamerV3's Variable-Rate Imagination"**~~ (deprecated — "delusional critic" conflicts with Lu et al. 2018)
3. **"Diagnosing Value Overestimation from Temporal Abstraction in DreamerV3"** ← preferred after D037 terminology decision
4. **"Conditioning-Induced Value Overestimation in Variable-Rate World-Model Imagination"**

**⚠️ D037 术语决定**: "delusional critic" → **"conditioning-induced value overestimation"** (简称 CIVO)。Lu et al. 2018 的 delusional bias 指 policy-class constraints 导致不可实现的 Q 值，本文机制是 model imprecision + learned conditioning amplification，概念不同。Dream 模拟三档审稿一致指出术语误导。全文替换："delusional critic" → "conditioning-induced value overestimation"，可 cite Lu et al. 2018 as analogy but must explicitly differentiate。

## Venue

**ICML 2026** — Deadline: 2026-05-29

## Narrative Positioning

This is a **diagnostic analysis paper**, not a method paper. We do not propose a new algorithm. Instead, we provide a systematic, controlled investigation answering: *Why does temporal abstraction fail in world-model RL?*

The contribution is a **strongly supported causal chain** from mechanism to failure mode, backed by a factorial experiment design that isolates each factor, plus a **practical mitigation guideline** (restrict imagination to dt=1 during multi-dt training → 95% baseline recovery). Diagnostic papers are valued when they (a) address a widely-attempted but poorly-understood failure, (b) provide actionable insight for future method design, and (c) are methodologically rigorous.

We scope all claims to **DreamerV3 and its RSSM world model**. Generalizability to other latent-dynamics architectures is discussed but not claimed.

---

## Core Claims

### C1: Variable-rate imagination in DreamerV3 consistently degrades performance

Temporal abstraction via variable dt—whether learned or fixed—degrades asymptotic performance relative to the dt=1 baseline across all tested configurations.

| Evidence | Experiment | Key Metric |
|----------|-----------|------------|
| Baseline stability | exp_001_baseline (dt=1) | Stable convergence ~950 eval return |
| Fixed dt=2 collapse | exp_006_fixed_dt2 (dt=2, subsample ON, H=15) | Peak 485@35K → collapse to ~135@65K |
| Fixed dt=4 severe degradation | exp_007_fixed_dt4 (dt=4) | Peak 176.9@25K, 144.4@45K (33% of baseline@45K=443) |
| Learned gate collapse | exp_005 (learned gate) | Peak 541@55K → 99@145K |

**Strength**: Strong. Three independent dt>1 configurations all show degradation. No positive result exists for variable-rate imagination in our setup.

### C2: Trained dt_embedding creates susceptibility to CIVO with stochastic onset; necessity confirmed by ablation

**D032/D156 update: CIVO onset is stochastic (Walker 3/3, Cheetah 3/4); necessity confirmed (frozen 0/10 across 2 envs × multiple seeds, removed 0/3+). Cross-env frozen verification 4/4 closed (exp_084-087, all NVE < 0.53×). Fisher exact test (6/7 onset vs 0/19 controls): p < 0.0001.**

The trained dt_embedding creates susceptibility to pathological value overestimation (normalized v/e >1.5x baseline) with stochastic onset. Both onset and collapse are stochastic:

- **Walker WITH trained dt_emb**: 3/3 seeds onset NVE>1.5× (exp_008d s0: sustained 1.71x@35K→2.09x@45K→4.12x@55K → collapse; exp_009e s1: onset >1.5×; exp_009b s2: 1.62x@45K → self-correction to 0.38x@105K). 2/3 sustained collapse, 1/3 self-corrected
- **Cheetah WITH trained dt_emb**: 3/4 seeds onset (exp_078 s0 NVE=4.1×; exp_091 s2 NVE=138.7×, onset_collapse; exp_097 s3 onset@45K NVE=2.3×, onset_transient_then_degraded, eval_final=61.7 (14% baseline); exp_088 s1 NVE≈1.0 no onset). **All onset seeds eval_final < 15% baseline; no-onset s1 = 69% baseline — CIVO onset causes irrecoverable performance damage even when ve_ratio self-corrects**

Cross-env frozen verification (exp_084-087, 2 envs × 2 seeds): all NVE<0.53×
- **1.5x threshold (Walker, 35K+)**: 4/4 perfect classification within Walker. Cross-environment onset rate ~86% (6/7 completed seeds) — not deterministic

**⚠️ 时间限定**: nve>1.5x 诊断适用于 **35K+ steps**（此时 baseline v/e 已充分收敛至 >0.24，比率稳定可靠）。25K 处 baseline v/e 仅 0.087，微小绝对差异可被放大为大比率（如 009b@25K nve=2.05x 和 008e_v3@25K nve=1.93x 均为 false positive）。论文中报告 threshold 时必须标注此限定。

**Sustained vs transient overestimation**: The key difference between collapse (008d seed 1) and self-correction (009b seed 2) is the **temporal persistence** of nve>1.5x. Seed 1 maintained nve>1.5x across 3 consecutive checkpoints at 35K+ (1.71x@35K→2.09x@45K→4.12x@55K, accelerating), locking the positive feedback loop; seed 2 exceeded 1.5x at 45K (1.62x) but dropped to 1.41x@55K and continued declining, allowing self-correction. This suggests a "point of no return" where sustained overestimation becomes irreversible, with early training stochasticity (initialization, data sampling order) determining which path is taken (cf. Henderson et al. 2018, Bjorck et al. 2022, Qiao et al. 2023).

The trained dt_embedding enables precise dt prediction in imagination, but RSSM state prediction quality at dt>1 is insufficient to support this precision. The result is conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO) that drives actor learning toward incorrect policies. Without dt_embedding conditioning, the overestimation feedback loop is blocked entirely (nve never exceeds 1.5x).

### C7: Gradient-level interventions fail to eliminate CIVO — gradient magnitude decoupled from causal importance

**⚠️ D107: SGS 全面失败，梯度干预不是正确的干预层级**

All three SGS variants fail to eliminate CIVO:
- **Reward-only SGS** (016e): 0/2, NVE=10.42× — paradoxically worse than untreated
- **Full-pathway SGS** (018+021): 0/3 across two environments — blocks all non-KL gradients, still fails
- **Obs-decoder-only SGS** (025+026): 1/6 across two environments — the identified causal channel, still fails

| Evidence | Experiment | Key Metric |
|----------|-----------|------------|
| Reward-only SGS 反效果 | exp_016e | NVE=10.42×, collapse to eval 31.7. 阻断 reward 梯度迫使 dt_emb 通过 obs-decoder 适配，强化空间偏差 |
| Full SGS 0/3 | exp_018 (Walker 2 seeds) + exp_021 (Cheetah 1 seed) | s1: eval 448.3, NVE 1.66× (CIVO+); s2: collapse 40.8; Cheetah: transient NVE 9.94×→0.34× (not SGS effect) |
| Obs-decoder SGS 1/6 | exp_025 (Walker 4 seeds) + exp_026 (Cheetah 2 seeds) | Walker: 1/4 (s1 survived, s2-s4 collapsed); Cheetah: 0/2, NVE 21.9×-30.2× (2.6-3.6× worse than untreated 8.3×) |
| Compensatory amplification (Cheetah) | exp_026 vs exp_010b | Obs-decoder SGS NVE 21.9-30.2× vs untreated 8.3× — blocking obs-decoder shifts co-adaptation to reward head |
| Universal value collapse | exp_025 all seeds @215K | All 4 seeds terminal ve_ratio=0.056-0.14, including s1 "success" (eval 726, value 41) — critic underestimation as side effect |

**核心发现**：
1. **梯度量级与因果重要性脱耦**: Reward head 38-49% 梯度占比（最大），但 reward-only SGS 失败最惨；obs decoder 16-22%（最小非零），但 obs-decoder SGS 也失败。梯度分解成功作为**诊断工具**但失败作为**干预指南**。
2. **Backward-pass 是错误的干预层级**: Full SGS 阻断所有非 KL 梯度仍 0/3 → forward-pass representational damage 是不可约减的脆弱性底线。Temporal embedding 通过 forward pass 塑造潜在表示，无论哪些梯度更新它。
3. **补偿放大**: 阻断任一通道导致剩余通道放大 co-adaptation（Cheetah: 2.6-3.6× 放大）。
4. **SGS 副作用**: 即使"成功"的 seed 也遭受 critic 校准损坏（universal value collapse）。

**Strength**: Strong. 17 seeds across 3 SGS variants and 2 environments. Only 1/17 avoids CIVO, and that seed still suffers value collapse. Embedding removal (008f+024b): 5/5 = 100% prevention. The contrast establishes gradient stopping as categorically insufficient.

### C8: Forward-pass interventions — TCN and RAVE (🔄 验证中)

**⚠️ D107/D108: 两种 forward-pass 干预方法并行验证**

SGS 失败的根因是 backward-pass 干预无法消除 forward-pass representational damage。C8 提出绕过梯度冗余的 forward-pass 干预：

**TCN (Temporal Conditioning Noise)**:
- 设计理念：imagination 时对 dt_embedding 输出加高斯噪声 $\mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$，降低 conditioning 精度
- 机制假说：噪声阻止 RSSM 和 critic 对精确 dt 信号的过度 co-adaptation，同时保留粗粒度时间信息
- 与 SGS 的区别：在 forward pass 层面操作，不依赖梯度阻断
- 超参：σ=0.5×std（主实验）+ σ=0.2×std（替代超参）
- 实验：exp_027_tcn_walker_s0 (σ=0.5), exp_027_tcn_walker_s0_sigma02 (σ=0.2)

**RAVE (Reality-Anchored Value Estimation)**:
- 设计理念：用 EMA 跟踪真实环境状态的值估计，当 imagined value 超过 EMA×ceiling 时截断
- 机制假说：直接限制 critic overestimation 的幅度，打断 CIVO 正反馈循环
- 与 SGS 的区别：不修改梯度流，而是在 value estimate 层面施加约束
- 超参：ceiling=2.0（主实验）+ ceiling=1.5（替代超参）
- 实验：exp_028_rave_walker_s0 (ceil=2.0), exp_028_rave_walker_s0_ceil15 (ceil=1.5)

**D113 全面评估完成 (2026-05-20) — Scenario B 确认：Intervention Hierarchy 论文**

## Story Arc

### 1. Introduction
- Temporal abstraction is a long-sought goal in RL (options, macro-actions, skip connections)
- World-model RL (DreamerV3) offers a natural testbed: modify imagination dt without changing environment interaction
- Puzzle: all our attempts at variable-rate imagination degrade performance. Why?
- Contribution: systematic factorial diagnosis identifying trained dt_embedding as creating susceptibility to conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO, nve>1.5x) with stochastic onset (Walker 3/3, Cheetah 3/4); removal/freezing consistently blocks it (0/7+). The vulnerability is deeper than imagination quality — even dt=1 imagination collapses at the same rate when dt_embedding is trained, revealing that training data dt>1 transitions alone drive the critic exploitation feedback loop

### 2. Background & Related Work
- Temporal abstraction in model-free RL (options framework, FiGAR, action repeat)
- World-model RL (Dreamer family, IRIS, TWM)
- Variable-rate planning in world models (few prior works, mostly positive framing)
- Value overestimation in model-based RL (delusional bias per Lu et al. 2018 — differentiate from our CIVO)

### 3. Methodology
- DreamerV3 as base architecture
- Variable-rate imagination: dt_embedding, temporal subsampling, learned gating
- **Factorial experiment design**: 2×2×2 grid (dt_embedding trained/untrained × subsample ON/OFF × H=8/15) + baselines
- Diagnostic metrics: eval return, value/eval ratio as overestimation proxy, learning curves

### 4. Results
- **Finding 1**: All dt>1 configurations degrade (C1)
- **Finding 2**: Controlled ablation isolates trained dt_embedding (C2) — the "smoking gun" comparison (008c vs 008d)
- **Finding 3**: Untrained dt_embedding prevents optimistic drift, sustaining near-baseline performance (C3)
- **Finding 4**: Longer dt amplifies (C4)
- **Finding 5**: Horizon/subsample effects are secondary (C5)
- **Finding 6 (D153 confirmed)**: dt=1 imagination deterministically prevents CIVO (4/4 seeds, current code after gate_max_dt bug fix). Practical mitigation: retain trained dt_embedding benefits while eliminating CIVO trigger pathway (C6)

### 5. Discussion
- Mechanism: why trained dt_embedding causes CIVO (RSSM fidelity gap at dt>1)
- RSSM fidelity analysis: Walker 008d reward gap (1.63x, v3 standardized) vs 008f reward gap (1.01x); Cheetah trained_dt_emb reward gap (1.00x) — environment-dependent transmission pathway (D158)
- **D153: dt=1 imagination confirmed as deterministic mitigation** (4/4 seeds, gate_max_dt bug fixed). Old "Pathway B" was bug artifact
- **D107: Gradient-level interventions fail entirely**: SGS 0/3 (full) + 1/6 (obs-decoder) + 0/2 (reward-only) = backward-pass is categorically insufficient. Gradient magnitude ≠ causal importance (reward 38-49% but reward-only SGS fails worst; obs-decoder 16-22% but targeted SGS also fails). Forward-pass representational damage is the irreducible floor.
- **Compensatory amplification**: Blocking obs-decoder on Cheetah → 2.6-3.6× NVE amplification vs untreated. Blocking reward → obs-decoder reliance increases → spatial bias reinforced.
- **Universal value collapse**: Obs-decoder SGS degrades all seeds' critic calibration (ve_ratio 0.056-0.14 @215K), including CIVO-free seeds. "Protection" = trading overestimation for underestimation.
- **Fourth CIVO trajectory (s3)**: Latent onset → delayed collapse → policy recovery → persistent value collapse. CIVO-induced critic damage may be irreversible.
- MPC vs imagination: TAWM succeeds because MPC re-plans from real states; imagination-based critic bootstrapping creates the positive feedback loop
- **D032: Value self-correction mechanism (009b)**: Transient vs sustained nve>1.5x determines outcome. Early stochasticity (initialization, data sampling) is the gate.

### 6. Implications for Future Work
- **D113: Intervention Hierarchy — all three levels fail or partially fail**: Gradient (SGS 1/17), Output (RAVE 0/2), Representation (TCN 2/8 with high variance). dt_embedding removal 5/5 but removes the feature entirely.
- TCN existence proof (Walker σ=0.2) shows mitigation is *possible in principle* but fragile — narrow dose window, environment-dependent, high seed variance in eval retention
- **Dose-environment dependency**: No universal σ exists; Walker-effective dose (σ=0.2) underdoses Cheetah/PickCube, Walker-overdose (σ=0.5) still underdoses Cheetah
- RSSM prediction quality must improve before variable-rate imagination is viable
- Hierarchical temporal abstraction (THICK, Hieros) may avoid flat-conditioning failure by maintaining separate dynamics per temporal scale
- Need for diagnostic methodology in temporal abstraction research

## Anticipated Reviewer Concerns

### R1: "Limited to one environment / one base algorithm"
**Pre-emption**: Our claims are mechanistic (trained dt_embedding → value overestimation → collapse). The causal chain is architecture-specific by design—we diagnose *why* it fails in DreamerV3, not whether it fails everywhere. The trained dt_embedding mechanism may have analogues in other latent-dynamics models, though the specific transmission pathway (RSSM fidelity gap vs value extrapolation) appears environment-dependent.
**Mitigation**: Cheetah Run is a planned experiment in our experiment schedule, not a stretch goal. We will include at least one additional DMC environment (Cheetah Run) to demonstrate generality of the mechanism.

### R2: "No proposed solution — what's the actionable takeaway?"
**Pre-emption**: Our primary contribution is diagnostic, not prescriptive. Beyond diagnosis, we provide a **systematic Intervention Hierarchy** evaluating 7+ methods across 3 levels (gradient/output/representation) and 3 environments. This is the most comprehensive evaluation of CIVO interventions to date. The key finding: even the most promising intervention (TCN, representation-level) succeeds only under narrow conditions (Walker σ=0.2, 2/8 configs, 45-91% eval retention). The actionable takeaway is that CIVO requires fundamental architectural solutions (hierarchical temporal abstraction per THICK/Hieros), not post-hoc interventions.
**Mitigation**: The Intervention Hierarchy table (7 methods × 3 levels) is a standalone contribution — it saves future researchers from re-exploring these dead ends and provides a systematic framework for evaluating future interventions.

### R3: "Value/eval ratio is a crude proxy for overestimation"
**Pre-emption**: We acknowledge this is a proxy, not a formal divergence measure. However, the v/e overshoot ratio (experiment v/e / baseline v/e at same step) consistently identifies pathological overestimation: trained dt_emb variants exceed 1.5x baseline v/e before collapse, while untrained variants stay at or below baseline levels.
**Mitigation**: Add distributional analysis of value predictions vs. realized returns if time permits.

### R4: "The factorial design is incomplete — missing cells in the grid"
**Pre-emption**: We prioritized the most informative comparisons. The 008c vs 008d pair isolates dt_embedding training with all else held constant—this is the critical controlled experiment.
**Mitigation**: Explicitly present the factorial grid, mark which cells are filled, and justify the prioritization.

### R5: "Novelty concern — model exploitation / value overestimation in MBRL is well-known"
**Pre-emption**: General MBRL overestimation is known (Janner et al., 2019), but three elements are genuinely novel: (a) **MPC vs imagination architectural boundary** — first empirical evidence that dt-conditioning succeeds in MPC (TAWM) but fails in imagination-based AC, localizing vulnerability to critic bootstrapping architecture; (b) **gradient magnitude ≠ causal importance** — reward head carries 38-49% of gradients but is causally irrelevant, obs-decoder carries 16-22% but is causally critical (broader methodological insight for multi-head MBRL debugging); (c) **systematic three-level intervention hierarchy** — not a single failure report but a complete taxonomy of 7 methods × 3 levels with structured negative evidence.
**Mitigation**: Expand Related Work to engage deeply with MBPO framework, explicitly articulate what CIVO reveals that MBPO does not predict (the specific *trigger* through temporal conditioning, the MPC/imagination divergence, the gradient-causality dissociation).

### R6: "All results from a single seed — how robust are the conclusions?"
**Pre-emption (D032 update)**: Multi-seed data now available. The nve>1.5x diagnostic threshold achieves **4/4 perfect classification** across seeds: trained dt_emb (008d seed 1, 009b seed 2) both exceed 1.5x; untrained (008f seed 1, 009c seed 2) neither exceeds 1.5x. Both onset (Walker 3/3, Cheetah 3/4; cross-env 6/7=86%) and collapse (~50% of onset seeds) are stochastic, which we report transparently. Our claim is that trained dt_emb creates susceptibility (necessity confirmed by 0/7+ controls), not deterministic failure.
**[D153]** C6 confirmed: old 008e_v3_s2 collapse was caused by gate_max_dt=8 bug (D152). Current code 4/4 seeds stable with dt=1 imagination (exp_080/081/070/072). dt=1 imagination is a deterministic CIVO mitigation.
**Mitigation**: Report all seeds with IQM + confidence intervals per Agarwal et al. (2021). The 4/4 separation is robust. Additional seeds (009e, 009f) pending to further narrow collapse probability estimates.

### R7: "The factorial design confounds dt_embedding training with training data composition"
**Pre-emption**: exp_008f confirmed: dt_embed_dim=0 + subsample ON → normalized v/e 0.83x@45K (healthy), vs 008d@45K=2.09x (collapse at v/e=69.3%). This confirms dt_embedding conditioning—not RSSM learned dynamics—is the causal mechanism. exp_008f uses identical training data composition as 008d (subsample ON, dt=2 transitions) but removes dt_embedding conditioning. Through 55K, 008f remained in normal range (normalized v/e 0.73-1.02x).
**Mitigation**: The 008f causal control resolves this confound definitively. The three-way comparison (008c: subsample OFF/untrained, 008d: subsample ON/trained, 008f: subsample ON/no dt_embed) isolates dt_embedding conditioning as the necessary factor for CIVO (sufficient to create susceptibility, but onset is stochastic — Cheetah 3/4 seeds).

### R8: "008f reward prediction degradation undermines the causal control"
**Pre-emption**: 008f 的 reward_MAE=0.747（baseline 75x）是重要发现，但不削弱 C2 因果结论。008f 证明的是"去掉 dt_embedding → 不崩塌"，这个 collapse vs no-collapse 的区分不依赖 reward 质量。008f 的低 v/e 部分源于奖励噪声，但关键对比是 008d 的 v/e 加速发散 vs 008f 的 v/e 保持稳定——模式差异才是因果证据。
**Mitigation**: 论文中明确区分 008f 的角色（因果控制实验）和 008e_v3 的角色（诊断证据：dt=1 imagination 不能消除 CIVO）。RSSM fidelity 表同时报告绝对误差和比率，避免审稿人被 008d 的低 obs gap ratio（1.30x，但绝对误差 41.31 已是 baseline 3x）误导。

### R9: "Why not test standard overestimation countermeasures (Double Q, ensemble critics)?" [Dream D1 — 三档一致 #1 弱点] → **已实验回答 (D118-D123)**

**实验结果（D118-D124 dual-critic + mechanism ablation 系列）**：

**1. Dual-critic 跨环境结果（D128 更新）**：
- Walker wide dual-critic: **3/3 CIVO prevented**（s0 eval 739.7, s1 551.8, s2 ~121）。NVE 全程 < 1.5
  - ⚠️ **s2 非 CIVO 崩溃**：NVE 正常但 eval 354→121，actor entropy 急升(-3.59→-0.45)。可能是 policy exploration failure。**必须区分 "CIVO prevention"(3/3) vs "performance stability"(2/3)**
- Walker narrow dual-critic: 1/1 CIVO occurred (NVE 2.75) → full recovery eval 697.8
- Cheetah dual-critic: CIVO 发生(NVE 1.75) → 部分恢复 eval 97.5 (31%, 晚期下降)
- Cheetah wide single: CIVO 发生(NVE 3.59) → 自修复 eval 146 (晚期下降)。Wide > dual in Cheetah (146 vs 97.5)
- PickCube dual-critic: NVE 短暂升至 2.3 后自行修正，**PickCube 不触发持续性 CIVO**（任务动态不同）。eval 27.7 的低性能源于 gate 配置本身对 manipulation 任务有害（vanilla baseline 58.6 → 加 subsample+dt_emb 后 26.6），非 CIVO 导致。PickCube 作为 scope limitation 讨论，跨环境 CIVO 叙事聚焦 locomotion (Walker/Cheetah)
- **v1≈v2 across all environments and all configs**（ρ>0.999 Walker; exact match Cheetah/PickCube）

**2. v1≈v2 核心发现**：Double Q 的 pessimism 机制在 pure-imagination MBRL 中失效。两个 critic 共享相同 world model imagined features → 收敛到相同函数。Per-sample pessimism 仅为独立 critic 理论值的 3-4%（ρ>0.998）。

**3. 2×2 Mechanism Factorial（D126 — 全部 4 格填满）**：
| | Single critic | Dual critic (min) |
|--|--------------|-------------------|
| ~1.05-1.2M params | baseline (**CIVO → 永久崩溃**) | **exp_035 narrow: CIVO(NVE 2.75) → 恢复中 → eval 149+** |
| ~2.4-2.9M params | **exp_033 wide: CIVO(NVE 4.75) → 自修复 → eval 408** | **exp_032: CIVO 预防(NVE≤1.1) → eval 670-788** |

**4. 双维度发现（D127 最终修正 — 论文最核心新发现）**：

**Recovery 维度（min 是主导因素）**：
| 配置 | CIVO 发生? | NVE peak | eval final | 恢复能力 |
|------|-----------|----------|------------|---------|
| Baseline (single+normal) | ✓ | ~2-4 | collapsed | 无 |
| exp_033 (single+wide) | ✓ | 4.75 | 408 | 部分(capacity) |
| **exp_035 (dual+narrow)** | **✓** | **2.75** | **697.8** | **完全(min)** |
| exp_032 (dual+wide) | ✗ | ≤1.1 | 670-788 | 无需恢复 |

- **Min 的核心价值是 recovery 而非 prevention**：exp_035 eval 697.8 ≈ exp_032 670-788，尽管经历了 CIVO
- **Min >> Capacity for recovery**：697.8 vs 408。min 实现完全恢复，capacity 仅部分恢复
- **Min 同时降低 CIVO 严重度**：exp_035 NVE 2.75 < exp_033 NVE 4.75

**Prevention 维度（需 min+capacity 协同）**：
- 只有 exp_032 (min+capacity) 从未触发 CIVO（NVE≤1.1）
- Prevention 优势不是最终性能（≈recovery-with-min），而是**训练效率**（节省 ~40K steps 恢复期）
- v1≈v2 在所有 dual-critic 中成立（包括 exp_032）→ 协同效应是经验事实，机制为 hypothesis

**跨环境 caveat**：Walker 上 recovery 充分(697.8)，但 Cheetah 上 recovery 不充分(97.5, 31%)。环境越难，recovery 越不可靠 → prevention 在难环境中价值更大。

**⚠️ 机制为 open hypothesis**：v1≈v2 在所有 dual-critic 中成立。可能的解释：(a) min 在训练早期(v1≠v2 时)建立了稳定学习轨迹 (b) min-target coupling 在 wider network 的 smoother loss landscape 上更有效 (c) capacity 提升 value calibration 质量而非多样性。论文中诚实报告经验事实，机制标注为 hypothesis。

**论文 narrative（D127 最终版）**：双维度报告——(a) Prevention: min+capacity 协同预防 CIVO（训练效率优势）(b) Recovery: min 是 CIVO 后恢复的主导因素（被低估的特性）(c) 跨环境：难环境中 recovery 不充分，凸显 prevention 的必要性 (d) v1≈v2: pessimism 机制失效但 min 通过其他通路起效（open question）

**5. 环境依赖性（D125 — exp_034 完成）**：
- **Walker（中等 CIVO，untreated NVE 2-4）**：min 操作完全预防 CIVO（2/2 seeds）
- **Cheetah（高强度 CIVO，untreated NVE 8.27-70.64，seed 间高方差）**：min 操作将 NVE peak 从 baseline 8.27-70.64 降至 1.75（≥4× reduction），但仍超 1.5 阈值，不能完全预防。双倍参数(2.36M)实现部分恢复(eval 97.5)但仅达 pre-CIVO 峰值的 31% 且晚期下降。对比 Walker wide-critic(exp_033) 恢复到 408(>pre-CIVO)，说明**环境动力学复杂度是恢复质量的决定性因素**。（来源：exp_010b s0 NVE_final=70.64, s1 NVE_peak=8.27。论文中须报告两个 seed 并使用保守 claim "≥4× NVE reduction"，不用 40×）
- **论文 claim 限定**："min=prevention" 必须加 "in moderate-CIVO environments" 限定，否则审稿人拿 Cheetah 数据直接攻击。这反而强化 intervention hierarchy 叙事——即使 architecture-level 干预也有 CIVO 严重度边界

**论文 narrative（D126 修正）**：从"为什么不测标准对策"转为"我们测了——(a) pessimism 机制失效（v1≈v2 across all configs），(b) min alone 和 capacity alone 都不能预防 CIVO，(c) 两者协同（min+capacity）才能预防，(d) 机制：capacity 提供函数多样性 + min 约束 overestimation 反馈环，(e) prevention >> recovery"。2×2 factorial 的**交互效应**比任何单因素更有方法论启示——对 ML 社区的 critic 设计指导价值更高。

### R10: "NVE threshold is calibrated and validated in-sample" [Dream D8 — 三档一致]
**Pre-emption**: 承认 1.5× threshold 在同一 29 个数据点上 calibrate 和 validate。但 (a) Youden-optimal threshold (1.53×) 独立收敛到预设 1.5×，不是事后拟合；(b) 4 环境 × 多种 configs 提供 reasonable diversity；(c) ground truth labeling 基于 mechanism identification（CIVO vs non-CIVO dynamics），不是简单的 performance threshold。
**Mitigation**: 明确承认 limitation，建议 held-out validation（不同架构或环境）作为 future work。讨论 NVE 在不同 reward scale 下的 generalization boundary。

### R11: "Pixel observations would change the gradient decomposition" [Dream D9 — 三档一致]
**Pre-emption**: 正确——pixel 下 obs-decoder channel（本文识别为 16-22% 梯度但因果关键）会承载更多信息和更大梯度。CIVO 动态可能更强（更多空间信息可利用）或更弱（decoder 正则化效应更强）。这是一个重要的泛化性边界。
**Mitigation**: 在 limitations 中明确讨论，定位为 future work。强调本文在 proprioceptive setting 的发现建立了 CIVO 的基础机制理论，pixel 扩展需要后续工作。

1	% Method — Draft v2
2	% Target: CoRL 2026
3	% Status: Updated 2026-05-18 — All 6 Framing B diffs applied: DIFF-M2 (CIVO heading), DIFF-M3 (imagination causal variable), DIFF-M4 (gradient decomposition), DIFF-M5 (SGS informative negative), DIFF-M6 (2×2 ablation matrix), DIFF-M7 (NVE AUROC=0.958, 9/10). C6 NVE fix: 008e_v3 s3/s4 added.
4	% Note: Complements experimental_setup.md (Section 4). Some overlap in
5	%   diagnostic framework and factorial design is intentional—final paper
6	%   may merge or redistribute content between Sections 3 and 4.
7	
8	# 3. Methodology
9	
10	We present a systematic diagnostic methodology for identifying why variable-rate imagination fails in world-model reinforcement learning. Our approach combines (i) controlled factorial experiments that isolate individual causal factors, (ii) a normalized diagnostic metric that separates pathological value overestimation from benign overshoot, and (iii) a world-model fidelity analysis that grounds the failure mechanism in prediction error. All experiments use DreamerV3 \citep{hafner2023dreamerv3} on locomotion tasks from the DeepMind Control Suite \citep{tassa2018deepmind}: Walker Walk as the primary environment and Cheetah Run for cross-environment validation. We scope claims to this architecture and environment class.
11	
12	
13	## 3.1 Background: DreamerV3 and Variable-Rate Imagination
14	
15	### World-Model Actor-Critic
16	
17	DreamerV3 \citep{hafner2023dreamerv3} learns a latent dynamics model---the Recurrent State-Space Model (RSSM)---from environment interactions and trains an actor-critic entirely within imagined trajectories. The RSSM maintains a latent state $s_t = (h_t, z_t)$ consisting of a deterministic recurrent component $h_t$ and a stochastic discrete representation $z_t$. At each imagination step, the model predicts:
18	
19	$$h_{t+1} = f_\theta(h_t, z_t, a_t), \quad \hat{z}_{t+1} \sim p_\theta(\cdot \mid h_{t+1})$$
20	
21	An actor $\pi_\psi$ selects actions and a critic $V_\xi$ estimates $\lambda$-returns, both trained on imagined trajectories of horizon $H$ steps. In the standard configuration, each imagination step corresponds to one environment transition ($\Delta t = 1$) and $H = 15$.
22	
23	### Temporal Abstraction via Variable-Rate Imagination
24	
25	Temporal abstraction---reasoning at multiple timescales---is a longstanding goal in RL \citep{sutton1999options, precup2000temporal}. World-model RL provides a natural setting: by setting the imagination step size $\Delta t > 1$, the agent can plan over longer temporal horizons without increasing the number of imagination steps. An $H$-step rollout at $\Delta t = 2$ covers $2H$ environment steps of lookahead at the same computational cost as the standard $H$-step rollout.
26	
27	We introduce three modifications to the DreamerV3 imagination pipeline, each independently controllable:
28	
29	**Temporal step-size embedding.** An embedding $e_{\Delta t} \in \mathbb{R}^d$ conditions the RSSM transition on the step size:
30	
31	$$h_{t+\Delta t} = f_\theta(h_t, z_t, a_t, e_{\Delta t})$$
32	
33	We study three configurations: *trained* ($d{=}32$, jointly optimized with the world model), *untrained* ($d{=}32$, randomly initialized and frozen), and *removed* ($d{=}0$, no temporal conditioning). The trained embedding enables the RSSM to specialize predictions for different $\Delta t$ values; the untrained and removed configurations serve as controls.
34	
35	**Temporal subsampling.** When enabled, the replay buffer stores both $\Delta t{=}1$ and $\Delta t{=}2$ transitions (constructed by skipping alternate frames), exposing the RSSM to multi-rate dynamics during training. When disabled, only $\Delta t{=}1$ transitions are used for world-model training.
36	
37	**Imagination step size.** During actor-critic optimization, imagination rollouts use a fixed step size: $\Delta t{=}1$ (standard) or $\Delta t{>}1$ (variable-rate). This factor is independently controllable from the world model's training data composition.
38	
39	### Conditioning-Induced Value Overestimation (CIVO)
40	
41	When the RSSM predicts $\Delta t > 1$ transitions, it must extrapolate over a larger temporal gap, and state prediction fidelity degrades. With a trained temporal embedding, the critic $V_\xi$ receives precise $\Delta t$ information and can exploit the model's confident but inaccurate multi-step predictions to form systematically optimistic value estimates. If these overestimates persistently exceed achievable returns, the actor pursues policies that are optimal under the model but suboptimal in reality.
42	
43	We term this *conditioning-induced value overestimation (CIVO)*. The mechanism is analogous to Lu \& Schuurmans' \citep{lu2018nondelusional} delusional policies, where function approximation introduces inconsistencies in Q-learning backups, but the source differs: Lu et al.'s delusions are *policy-class-induced* (the policy's functional form cannot represent consistent backups), whereas CIVO is *model-induced* (the world model's temporal extrapolation error produces systematically biased latent states that the critic treats as accurate). The delusion source is the conditioning signal $e_{\Delta t}$ and the RSSM's degraded fidelity at $\Delta t > 1$, not the policy's representational capacity.
44	
45	
46	## 3.2 Diagnostic Framework: Normalized Value-Evaluation Ratio
47	
48	### Motivation
49	
50	Distinguishing pathological from benign value overestimation is the central diagnostic challenge. Even the standard DreamerV3 baseline exhibits value overshoot during training: at step 25K, the baseline's value-evaluation ratio is 0.087 (exp\_001\_baseline), rising to 0.656 by 105K as the critic converges. Any diagnostic metric must remove this baseline trend to isolate the *excess* overestimation attributable to variable-rate imagination.
51	
52	### Definition
53	
54	**Value-evaluation ratio.** At training step $k$:
55	
56	$$r_k = \frac{\bar{v}_k}{\bar{R}_k}$$
57	
58	where $\bar{v}_k$ is the mean predicted value across imagined states and $\bar{R}_k$ is the mean evaluation return over 10 episodes. This measures how closely the critic's estimates track achievable performance.
59	
60	**Normalized value-evaluation ratio (NVE).** We normalize by the baseline's ratio at the same step:
61	
62	$$\hat{r}_k = \frac{r_k^{\,\text{exp}}}{r_k^{\,\text{baseline}}}$$
63	
64	This removes the baseline's own overshoot trend, isolating excess overestimation. We normalize all v/e ratios against exp\_001 (DreamerV3 baseline, seed 1) at matched training steps. Sensitivity to baseline choice is reported in Appendix X.
65	
66	### Diagnostic Thresholds
67	
68	We calibrate thresholds from the observed separation between experimental conditions. We emphasize that these serve as empirical *markers*, not formal hypothesis tests---they are calibrated and evaluated on the same experiments:
69	
70	- **$\hat{r}_k > 1.5$ (at $k \geq$ 35K)**: **Pathological overestimation.** The critic overestimates far beyond baseline levels. This threshold achieves 4/4 classification accuracy across available seeds: both trained dt\_embedding conditions exceed 1.5$\times$ at 35K+ steps (exp\_008d seed 1: 1.71$\times$@35K $\to$ 2.09$\times$@45K; exp\_009b seed 2: 1.62$\times$@45K), while neither removed-embedding condition exceeds the threshold (exp\_008f seed 1 peak: 1.02$\times$@25K; exp\_009c seed 2 peak: 1.26$\times$@25K).
71	
72	- **$0.8 \leq \hat{r}_k \leq 1.2$**: **Normal range.** Value estimates track the baseline's overshoot pattern.
73	
74	- **$\hat{r}_k < 0.7$**: **Value suppression.** The critic underestimates returns relative to baseline, indicating conservative value learning.
75	
76	**Temporal validity constraint.** The NVE threshold applies only at $k \geq$ 35K steps, where the baseline $r_k > 0.24$ and ratios are stable. At earlier steps, the small baseline denominator amplifies noise: for example, exp\_009b at 25K shows NVE = 2.05$\times$ and exp\_008e\_v3 at 25K shows NVE = 1.93$\times$, both artifacts of the baseline's $r_{25\text{K}} = 0.087$ rather than genuine pathological overestimation. We report these early-step values for completeness but exclude them from diagnostic classification.
77	
78	**Aggregate diagnostic power.** Evaluating the 1.5$\times$ threshold across all ten Walker experiments (task B2), the NVE diagnostic achieves AUROC = 0.958 with 9/10 classification accuracy (Table~\ref{tab:nve_sensitivity}). The single false positive is exp\_008e\_v3\_s2, which exhibits late-onset NVE = 3.78$\times$ driven by eval collapse rather than value overestimation---a non-CIVO failure pathway analyzed in \S3.3. At the optimal B1 threshold of 3.9$\times$, the metric achieves 10/10 accuracy and AUROC = 1.0 (supplementary material).
79	
80	**Cross-environment onset reliability.** Across both Walker Walk and Cheetah Run, every trained-$e_{\Delta t}$ condition exhibits CIVO onset: 10/10 runs (8 Walker, 2 Cheetah) cross the pathological NVE threshold, while none of the 8 control conditions (removed or unexposed embedding) do (Fisher exact test, $p < 0.0001$). Onset timing is consistent across environments (${\sim}$45K steps). The Cheetah runs (exp\_010b, NVE peak 8.27$\times$; exp\_078, NVE peak 4.10$\times$) both self-correct, unlike Walker where 6/8 runs exhibit sustained collapse, indicating that onset is deterministic but outcome severity varies by environment (see Section~\ref{sec:cross_env} for full results).
81	
82	### Properties of the NVE Metric
83	
84	Two properties make NVE informative for detecting the CIVO:
85	
86	**Acceleration signature.** In pathological conditions, NVE does not merely exceed 1.5$\times$---it *accelerates*, reflecting a positive feedback loop between overestimated values and actor exploitation. Exp\_008d shows NVE = 1.71$\times$@35K $\to$ 2.09$\times$@45K $\to$ 4.12$\times$@55K, with each checkpoint further from baseline. Healthy conditions (exp\_008a, exp\_008f) show stable or declining NVE trajectories.
87	
88	**Collapse association.** Sustained NVE $>$ 1.5$\times$ across multiple consecutive checkpoints at 35K+ steps is associated with catastrophic performance collapse (exp\_008d seed 1: three consecutive checkpoints above 1.5$\times$, followed by eval return declining from 167 to 83). Transient exceedance followed by self-correction (exp\_009b seed 2: 1.62$\times$@45K $\to$ 1.41$\times$@55K $\to$ 0.94$\times$@65K, declining) does not lead to collapse. This pattern is consistent with a "point of no return" where the overestimation feedback loop becomes self-reinforcing, though with only two seeds under the trained-embedding condition, we report this association descriptively rather than as a statistical claim.
89	
90	
91	## 3.3 Causal Analysis Protocol
92	
93	### Design Rationale
94	
95	This is a diagnostic analysis. Our goal is to identify *which components* of variable-rate imagination cause degradation and trigger pathological overestimation, not to propose a new algorithm. We achieve this through controlled comparisons that vary one factor at a time, holding all others constant.
96	
97	### Factorial Structure
98	
99	We vary three factors (temporal embedding type $\times$ subsampling $\times$ horizon) across eight treatment conditions plus a baseline (see Table 1 in \S4 for the complete configuration matrix). Rather than filling all cells of the $3 \times 2 \times 2$ grid, we prioritize the comparisons most informative for causal isolation.
100	
101	### Causal Chain and Its Tests
102	
103	The causal chain under investigation is:
104	
105	$$\text{trained } e_{\Delta t} \;\xrightarrow{\text{Link 1}}\; \text{pathological NVE} \;\xrightarrow{\text{Link 2}}\; \text{actor exploitation} \;\xrightarrow{\text{Link 3}}\; \text{performance collapse}$$
106	
107	Each link is tested by a specific controlled comparison:
108	
109	**Link 1: Trained dt\_embedding $\to$ pathological overestimation.** The comparison between exp\_008d (trained dt\_embedding, $d{=}32$) and exp\_008f (removed dt\_embedding, $d{=}0$) isolates the effect of temporal embedding conditioning with all other factors held constant (subsample ON, $H{=}8$, $\Delta t{=}2$ imagination). Exp\_008d exhibits accelerating NVE (1.71$\times$@35K $\to$ 2.09$\times$@45K), while exp\_008f remains in the normal range (0.73$\times$@35K $\to$ 0.83$\times$@45K). This is the primary causal evidence.
110	
111	**Link 2: Sustained overestimation $\to$ collapse (stochastic).** Multi-seed replication reveals that the NVE $>$ 1.5$\times$ marker is reliable across seeds and environments (10/10 trained-$e_{\Delta t}$ runs exceed the threshold vs.\ 0/8 controls; Fisher exact $p < 0.0001$), but collapse is stochastic: in Walker, seed 1 (exp\_008d) shows sustained NVE $>$ 1.5$\times$ across three checkpoints and collapses (6/8 runs sustained collapse); seed 2 (exp\_009b) shows transient exceedance and self-corrects. Both Cheetah runs self-correct despite crossing the threshold. We report this stochasticity transparently---the diagnostic marker is reliable; collapse is a probabilistic downstream outcome modulated by environment dynamics.
112	
113	**Link 3: Imagination $\Delta t$ as the critical variable.** Exp\_008e\_v3 uses a trained dt\_embedding (identical to exp\_008d and exp\_006) but restricts imagination rollouts to $\Delta t{=}1$, with subsample ON and $H{=}15$. This condition achieves eval return 869.9 at 105K steps (95% of baseline 915.67; exp\_008e\_v3, seed 1) with NVE = 0.80$\times$ (healthy). The contrast with exp\_006 (same trained dt\_embedding, subsample ON, $H{=}15$, but $\Delta t{=}2$ imagination $\to$ collapse at 55K) isolates the imagination step size as the critical variable. The trained embedding itself is not harmful; the problem arises when the actor-critic *exploits* the embedding's $\Delta t > 1$ predictions during imagination.
114	
115	### 2$\times$2 Ablation Matrix
116	
117	To close the causal loop, we cross dt\_embedding configuration (trained / frozen / removed) with temporal subsampling (ON / OFF), isolating the necessary condition for sustained CIVO:
118	
119	| dt\_embedding | Subsample | Exp | Peak NVE (35K+) | Outcome |
120	|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
121	| Trained ($d{=}32$) | ON | 008d | 4.12$\times$@55K (sustained $\uparrow$) | CIVO $\to$ collapse |
122	| Trained ($d{=}32$) | OFF | 008a | 0.93$\times$@55K | Stable, 85\% baseline@105K |
123	| Frozen ($d{=}32$) | ON | 015b | 1.45$\times$@55K $\to$ 0.65$\times$@65K | Sub-threshold transient; gradient starvation collapse |
124	| Removed ($d{=}0$) | ON | 008f | $\leq$1.02$\times$ | No CIVO |
125	
126	Trained dt\_embedding is the necessary condition for sustained CIVO (NVE $>$ 1.5$\times$ across consecutive checkpoints). Frozen embedding produces sub-threshold transient overestimation (exp\_015b: peak 1.45$\times$@55K) that self-corrects to 0.65$\times$@65K before collapsing through a distinct gradient starvation mechanism (actor loss $\to$ 0 as the frozen embedding drifts from the RSSM's evolving representations). Removing the embedding entirely (exp\_008f, $d{=}0$) blocks CIVO: NVE never exceeds 1.02$\times$. The subsample-OFF condition (exp\_008a) confirms that a trained embedding without exposure to $\Delta t{>}1$ training data also avoids CIVO, establishing that both embedding capacity *and* multi-rate training data are jointly required to trigger the overestimation feedback loop.
127	
128	### Supporting Analyses
129	
130	**Horizon effect (C5).** Exp\_008c ($H{=}8$) vs. exp\_008a ($H{=}15$), both with trained-but-unexposed dt\_embedding and subsample OFF, shows that longer imagination horizons improve learning quality independently of the CIVO mechanism (exp\_008a: 778@105K; exp\_008c: 241@65K plateau).
131	
132	**Temporal distance amplification (C4).** Exp\_006 ($\Delta t{=}2$, peak 485@35K $\to$ collapse) vs. exp\_007 ($\Delta t{=}4$, peak 177@25K, severe degradation) shows monotonic performance decline with increasing $\Delta t$, consistent with compounding RSSM prediction errors. Only two $\Delta t$ values are tested; we report the monotonic trend (dt=1 $\approx$950 $>$ dt=2 peak 485 $>$ dt=4 peak 177) without stronger generalization claims.
133	
134	### RSSM Fidelity Analysis
135	
136	To ground the CIVO mechanism in world-model prediction quality, we analyze RSSM fidelity by measuring observation prediction error (MSE) and reward prediction error (MAE) at $\Delta t{=}1$ vs. $\Delta t{=}2$ across three conditions (exp\_rssm\_fidelity\_analysis):
137	
138	| Condition | $\Delta t{=}1$ obs MSE | $\Delta t{=}2$ obs MSE | Obs gap | $\Delta t{=}1$ rew MAE | $\Delta t{=}2$ rew MAE | Rew gap |
139	|-----------|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
140	| Baseline (exp\_001) | 13.49 | 27.50 | 2.04$\times$ | 0.0102 | 0.0159 | 1.56$\times$ |
141	| 008d (trained emb) | 41.31 | 53.67 | 1.30$\times$ | 0.0568 | 0.1579 | 2.78$\times$ |
142	| 008f (no emb) | 8.01 | 22.04 | 2.75$\times$ | 0.7469 | 0.7526 | 1.01$\times$ |
143	
144	Two patterns are diagnostically relevant:
145	
146	1. **Trained embedding enables differentiated but biased reward predictions.** In exp\_008d, the reward head produces sharply different predictions for $\Delta t{=}1$ vs. $\Delta t{=}2$ (reward gap 2.78$\times$), but these differentiated predictions rest on poor absolute state quality ($\Delta t{=}1$ obs MSE = 41.31, 3.1$\times$ baseline). The critic receives confident but systematically biased reward signals at $\Delta t{=}2$, fueling value overestimation.
147	
148	2. **Removing the embedding prevents differentiation but degrades reward quality.** In exp\_008f, the reward head cannot distinguish $\Delta t$ values (gap 1.01$\times$), blocking the systematic bias that drives the CIVO. However, this comes at the cost of severely degraded reward prediction (MAE = 0.747, 73$\times$ baseline). Exp\_008f is therefore a *causal control* that confirms the dt\_embedding's role in overestimation, not a recommended configuration.
149	
150	**Caveat on obs gap ratios.** Exp\_008d's low obs gap ratio (1.30$\times$) is misleading---its $\Delta t{=}1$ absolute error is already 3.1$\times$ baseline, indicating the model has degraded overall. We report both absolute errors and ratios to avoid ratio-only comparisons that could obscure this.
151	
152	### Gradient Decomposition of the Temporal Embedding
153	\label{sec:gradient_decomposition}
154	
155	To identify which loss component drives $e_{\Delta t}$'s learned representation, we decompose $\nabla_\theta e_{\Delta t}$ by loss term using \texttt{torch.autograd.grad}, measuring each component's gradient norm at step 95K (D061). DreamerV3's joint loss \citep{hafner2023dreamerv3} sums observation reconstruction, reward prediction, continuation, and KL regularization terms; each backpropagates through the shared RSSM latent state to reach $e_{\Delta t}$.
156	
157	| Loss component | Gradient norm | Share (\%) |
158	|----------------|:---:|:---:|
159	| Observation decoders (orientations, velocity, height) | 1.505 | 93 |
160	| KL dynamics | 0.119 | 7 |
161	| Continuation head | $<$0.001 | $<$1 |
162	| Reward head | 0.000 | 0 |
163	
164	The temporal embedding receives 93\% of its gradient from observation reconstruction and numerically negligible---zero to within floating-point precision---from the reward head (D061). This gradient imbalance is consistent with findings that observation reconstruction dominates reward learning in DreamerV3-type world models \citep{shang2024harmonydream}, and represents an extreme instance of multi-task gradient magnitude imbalance \citep{chen2018gradnorm}. Three implications follow:
165	
166	1. **Exp\_016e is an architectural no-op.** The reward-only stop-gradient surgery (Section~\ref{sec:sgs_negative}) detaches a gradient that does not exist. Its null effect is structurally determined, not an empirical surprise.
167	
168	2. **$e_{\Delta t}$ is shaped by observation reconstruction, not reward prediction.** The embedding learns temporal information that helps observation decoders minimize reconstruction error. If this induces systematic biases in latent states at $\Delta t{>}1$---states that are easy to decode but dynamically inaccurate---these biases propagate to all downstream heads, including the critic's value estimates. CIVO thus originates in the observation reconstruction objective, not the reward pathway.
169	
170	3. **Full SGS is the correct gradient-level intervention.** A meaningful intervention must address the dominant 93\% contribution from observation decoders. This motivates the full SGS design (exp\_018), which detaches $e_{\Delta t}$ from all non-KL gradient pathways.
171	
172	### Stop-Gradient Surgery: An Informative Negative (exp\_016e)
173	\label{sec:sgs_negative}
174	
175	The gradient decomposition above was motivated by a null result: exp\_016e, a reward-only stop-gradient surgery (SGS) that failed to attenuate CIVO. This negative result is informative because it constrains the space of viable interventions and reveals the architectural structure of gradient flow through $e_{\Delta t}$.
176	
177	**Configuration.** Exp\_016e replicates exp\_008d's CIVO-exhibiting setup (Walker Walk, trained $e_{\Delta t}$, subsampling ON, $H{=}8$, $\Delta t{=}2$ imagination) with one modification: \texttt{reward\_dt\_emb\_detach=True}, which applies $\text{sg}(\cdot)$ to $e_{\Delta t}$ before the reward head during the backward pass.
178	
179	**Results.** Exp\_016e collapses in the same qualitative pattern as exp\_008d. Peak eval return reaches 326.7 at 75K (exp\_016e), then drops to 31.7 by 95K---a 90.3\% decline. NVE remains in the normal range through 85K, then spikes to 10.42$\times$ at 95K (exp\_016e). The timing difference relative to exp\_008d (which crosses the pathological NVE threshold at 35K) cannot be attributed to the intervention, since the intervention is an architectural no-op (Section~\ref{sec:gradient_decomposition}); seed-level stochasticity is the parsimonious explanation.
180	
181	**Why this is an architectural no-op.** The gradient decomposition (Table above) shows the reward head contributes zero gradient to $e_{\Delta t}$. Detaching a zero-gradient pathway changes nothing. The reward head's negligible contribution arises from DreamerV3's architecture: the observation decoders' high-dimensional output space (24 dimensions vs.\ 1 scalar reward) dominates the gradient signal to $e_{\Delta t}$ by two orders of magnitude.
182	
183	**Implication for intervention design.** Any strategy targeting the reward head alone---reward prediction regularization, reward-conditioned value clipping, or reward-pathway stop-gradient---addresses $<$1\% of the gradient flow to $e_{\Delta t}$ and is unlikely to mitigate CIVO. Effective interventions must operate on the observation reconstruction pathway, either by modifying gradient flow (full SGS, exp\_018) or by restructuring how $e_{\Delta t}$ interacts with the RSSM transition function.
184	
185	### Imagination Step Size as Causal Variable
186	
187	The factorial analysis isolates the imagination step size as the causal variable that triggers CIVO. Two lines of evidence support this:
188	
189	**$\Delta t{=}1$ imagination removes CIVO (seed 1).** Exp\_008e\_v3 uses the same trained dt\_embedding and multi-rate training data as exp\_008d (the primary CIVO-exhibiting condition), but restricts imagination rollouts to $\Delta t{=}1$ with $H{=}15$. At 105K steps, it achieves eval return 869.9 (exp\_008e\_v3, seed 1), 95\% of baseline (exp\_001\_baseline: 915.67@105K), with NVE = 0.80$\times$ (healthy range). The trained embedding itself is not harmful; the problem arises only when the actor-critic exploits $\Delta t > 1$ predictions during imagination.
190	
191	**$\Delta t{=}1$ imagination does not prevent all failure modes (seed 2).** Exp\_008e\_v3\_s2 replicates the same configuration with seed 2 and exhibits catastrophic collapse: eval return peaks at 715 early in training, then declines to 137 by 105K steps (exp\_008e\_v3\_s2), with NVE = 3.78$\times$ at the final checkpoint. This collapse co-occurs with rising entropy (exp\_008e\_v3\_s2), contrasting with the entropy-decreasing, value-driven collapse signature of CIVO in exp\_008d.
192	
193	**Dual-pathway analysis.** The seed-1 vs. seed-2 divergence reveals two distinct failure pathways:
194	
195	- *Pathway A (CIVO):* Trained dt\_embedding + $\Delta t{>}1$ imagination $\to$ value overestimation (NVE $\uparrow$) $\to$ actor over-exploitation (entropy $\downarrow$) $\to$ performance collapse. Observed in exp\_008d (seed 1) and exp\_009b (seed 2, transient).
196	
197	- *Pathway B (non-CIVO):* $\Delta t{=}1$ imagination, no value overestimation trigger, but eval-driven collapse with entropy increase. Observed in exp\_008e\_v3\_s2 (seed 2). The rising entropy signature suggests exploration failure or policy instability unrelated to the CIVO mechanism.
198	
199	To rule out seed fragility as the explanation for Pathway B, we verify that the baseline is stable at seed 2: exp\_009a (DreamerV3 baseline, seed 2) achieves eval return 911.2 at 105K steps (exp\_009a), comparable to seed 1's 915.67 (exp\_001\_baseline). The collapse in exp\_008e\_v3\_s2 is therefore attributable to the interaction between multi-rate training and seed-specific dynamics, not to inherent instability at seed 2.
200	
201	**Implication.** Restricting imagination to $\Delta t{=}1$ eliminates Pathway A (CIVO) but does not guarantee stable training. The $\Delta t{=}1$ configuration is a *diagnostic control* confirming the causal role of imagination step size, not a robust mitigation strategy.
